definitions.text_mt: Kiel jew bela' l-ikel b'mod eċċessiv, iktar milli hemm bżonn
Tgħaddas jew indaħħal f'xi ħaġa, spiss bit-tgawdija

usage_examples.mt: Il-kelb iffanga l-ikla kollu f'daqqa.
usage_examples.en: The dog ate the whole meal excessively all at once.

usage_examples.mt: Wara x-xita, il-ħnieżer bdew jiffangaw fit-tajn.
usage_examples.en: After the rain, the pigs began to wallow in the mud.

definitions.text_mt: Immarka jew żejjen b'faxx jew strixxi
Għotti jew libes faxxa madwar ferita jew parti tal-ġisem

usage_examples.mt: Il-pittur iffaxxja l-ħajt bi strixxi bojod u suwed.
usage_examples.en: The painter striped the wall with white and black bands.

usage_examples.mt: In-nurse ffaxxjat idejh wara l-operazzjoni.
usage_examples.en: The nurse bandaged his arm after the operation.

usage_examples.mt: Għandek tiffaxxja l-ferita qabel tmur għand it-tabib.
usage_examples.en: You should bandage the wound before going to the doctor.

etymology_chain.definition: to occupy, to keep busy, to keep engaged in a task

definitions.text_mt: Baqa' okkupat b'xogħol tad-dar jew inkwiet domestiku kontinwu

usage_examples.mt: Ommi qatt ma tieqaf; dejjem tiffaċenda xi ħaġa madwar id-dar.
usage_examples.en: My mother never stops; she is always keeping busy with housework around the house.

usage_examples.mt: Wara l-pranzu, hija ffaċendat sa filgħaxija tard.
usage_examples.en: After lunch, she kept busy with housework until late evening.

definitions.text_mt: Baqa' okkupat b'xogħol tad-dar jew inkwiet domestiku kontinwu

usage_examples.mt: Il-ġirien tiegħi dejjem jiffaċendjaw fil-ġnien filgħodu.
usage_examples.en: My neighbours are always keeping busy with housework in the garden in the morning.

usage_examples.mt: Hija ffaċendjat il-ġurnata kollha tnaddaf u tirranġa.
usage_examples.en: She kept herself busy the whole day cleaning and tidying up.

definitions.text_mt: Għamel xi ħaġa aktar faċli jew aktar sempliċi biex issir

usage_examples.mt: Is-software il-ġdid jiffaċilita l-ipproċessar tad-data.
usage_examples.en: The new software facilitates the processing of data.

usage_examples.mt: Din il-miżura se tiffaċilita l-komunikazzjoni bejn iż-żewġ dipartimenti.
usage_examples.en: This measure will facilitate communication between the two departments.

definitions.text_mt: Preżenta ruħu quddiem xi ħadd jew f'xi sitwazzjoni
Qagħad wiċċ imb wiċċ ma' xi ħaġa jew xi ħadd

usage_examples.mt: Huwa ffaċċa ruħu mal-kap tal-kumpanija b'kuraġġ.
usage_examples.en: He presented himself before the company director with courage.

usage_examples.mt: Għandna niffaċċjaw il-problemi tagħna minflok naħarbu minnhom.
usage_examples.en: We should face our problems instead of running away from them.

definitions.text_mt: Qatta' jew ħaffer wiċċ ta' ġebla prezzjuża f'faċċetti

usage_examples.mt: Il-ġojjellier ffaċċettja d-djamant b'preċiżjoni kbira.
usage_examples.en: The jeweller faceted the diamond with great precision.

usage_examples.mt: Din il-ġebla prezzjuża ġiet iffaccettjata b'mod perfett.
usage_examples.en: This precious stone was faceted perfectly.

definitions.text_mt: Preżenta ruħu quddiem xi ħadd jew f'xi sitwazzjoni
Qagħad wiċċ imb wiċċ ma' xi ħaġa jew xi ħadd

usage_examples.mt: Huwa ffaċċja lill-awtoritajiet mingħajr biża'.
usage_examples.en: He presented himself before the authorities without fear.

usage_examples.mt: Il-bini jiffaċċja t-triq prinċipali.
usage_examples.en: The building faces the main road.

usage_examples.mt: Għandna niffaċċjaw ir-realtà u nħarsu 'l quddiem.
usage_examples.en: We must face reality and look forward.

definitions.text_mt: Għaqad flimkien f'federazzjoni jew f'unjoni waħda

usage_examples.mt: L-istati diversi ffederaw biex jiffurmaw pajjiż wieħed.
usage_examples.en: The various states federated to form one country.

usage_examples.mt: Huma jippjanaw li jiffederaw is-sindakati kollha taħt organizzazzjoni waħda.
usage_examples.en: They plan to federate all the unions under one organisation.

definitions.text_en: to fence, to erect a fence
definitions.text_mt: Benna ħajt jew xibka madwar art jew proprjetà biex jagħlaqha

usage_examples.mt: Il-bidwi ffensja l-għalqa tiegħu biex iżomm il-bhejjem ġewwa.
usage_examples.en: The farmer fenced his field to keep the livestock inside.

usage_examples.mt: Għandna bżonn niffensjaw il-ġnien qabel ma ndaħħlu l-klieb.
usage_examples.en: We need to fence the garden before we bring the dogs in.

definitions.text_mt: Ipprovda l-flus meħtieġa għal xi proġett, negozju, jew attività

usage_examples.mt: Il-bank ffinanzja l-proġett tal-kostruzzjoni tal-iskola l-ġdida.
usage_examples.en: The bank financed the construction project of the new school.

usage_examples.mt: Min se jiffinanzja l-istudji tiegħek fl-università?
usage_examples.en: Who will finance your studies at university?

definitions.text_mt: L-att tal-finanzjar jew il-provvediment ta' fondi għal xi skop

usage_examples.mt: L-ffinanzjar tal-proġett ġie approvat mill-bord.
usage_examples.en: The financing of the project was approved by the board.

usage_examples.mt: Hemm bżonn ta' ffinanzjar addizzjonali biex titlesta l-binja.
usage_examples.en: Additional financing is needed to complete the building.

definitions.text_mt: Baqa' wieqaf jew iffissa ħsibijietu fuq ħaġa waħda b'mod eċċessiv

definitions.text_en: to fix, arrange, set, sort out
definitions.text_mt: Irranġa, stabbilixxa, jew qiegħed xi ħaġa f'postha b'mod preċiż
Ipproċessa film fotografiku biex iżżomm l-immaġni b'mod permanenti
Żamm ħsieb wieħed f'moħħu b'mod iebes u persistenti

usage_examples.mt: Huwa ffissa fuq l-idea li jrid isir sinjur mil-lum għal għada.
usage_examples.en: He obsessed over the idea of becoming rich overnight.

usage_examples.mt: Jekk jogħġbok, fissal-id-data tal-laqgħa għal nhar it-Tnejn.
usage_examples.en: Please set the date of the meeting for Monday.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fotografu ffissa l-immaġni fil-kamra mudlama.
usage_examples.en: The photographer fixed the image in the darkroom.

etymology_chain.definition: to weary, to exhaust, to weaken, to sap

definitions.text_mt: Ħass il-ġuħ, kellu aptit qawwi għall-ikel

usage_examples.mt: Wara ġurnata twila fuq ix-xogħol, jien inffjakka.
usage_examples.en: After a long day at work, I get hungry.

usage_examples.mt: It-tfal jiffjakkaw wara li jilagħbu ħafna.
usage_examples.en: The children get hungry after playing a lot.

etymology_chain.definition: to flower, to bloom, to blossom, to effloresce [auxiliary essere ]

definitions.text_mt: Kiber jew żviluppa b'mod b'saħħtu u ta' suċċess
Fetaħ il-fjuri, nebbieta

usage_examples.mt: In-negozju tiegħu ffjora minkejja l-kriżi ekonomika.
usage_examples.en: His business flourished despite the economic crisis.

usage_examples.mt: Il-ward fil-ġnien tagħna jiffjora fir-rebbiegħa.
usage_examples.en: The roses in our garden bloom in spring.

etymology_chain.definition: to flower, to bloom, to blossom, to effloresce [auxiliary essere ]

definitions.text_mt: Kiber jew żviluppa b'mod b'saħħtu u ta' suċċess
Fetaħ il-fjuri, nebbieta

usage_examples.mt: L-arti u l-kultura ffjorixxew f'dak il-perjodu ta' paċi.
usage_examples.en: Art and culture flourished in that period of peace.

usage_examples.mt: Is-siġar tal-lewż jiffjorixxu kmieni fir-rebbiegħa.
usage_examples.en: The almond trees blossom early in spring.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kumpanija ffjorixxiet taħt it-tmexxija l-ġdida.
usage_examples.en: The company flourished under the new leadership.

etymology_chain.definition: to flower, to bloom, to blossom, to effloresce [auxiliary essere ]

definitions.text_mt: Kiber jew żviluppa b'mod b'saħħtu u ta' suċċess
Fetaħ il-fjuri, nebbieta

usage_examples.mt: L-ekonomija ffjurixxiet wara r-riformi.
usage_examples.en: The economy flourished after the reforms.

usage_examples.mt: Dawn il-pjanti jiffjurixxu biss fix-xemx sħiħa.
usage_examples.en: These plants blossom only in full sun.

definitions.text_mt: Ħa stampa ta' xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa b'kamera

usage_examples.mt: Il-fotografu ffotografa lill-koppja l-ġdida fil-bajja.
usage_examples.en: The photographer photographed the newly-wed couple on the beach.

usage_examples.mt: Tħobb tiffotografa n-natura meta tmur għall-mixjiet.
usage_examples.en: She likes to photograph nature when she goes on walks.

usage_examples.mt: Il-mumenti l-aktar importanti tal-festa ġew iffotografati.
usage_examples.en: The most important moments of the feast were photographed.

definitions.text_en: to catch something with a harpoon, trident, etc.
definitions.text_mt: Qabad xi ħaġa b'foxxna jew arma simili
Kiel bil-ħerqa jew bil-ġirja, bela' l-ikel b'mod gluttonuż

usage_examples.mt: Is-sajjied ffoxxna ħuta kbira mill-baħar.
usage_examples.en: The fisherman harpooned a large fish from the sea.

usage_examples.mt: Huwa ffoxxna l-ikel kollu fuq il-mejda fi ftit minuti.
usage_examples.en: He ate all the food on the table greedily in a few minutes.

etymology_chain.definition: to stamp ( to put stamps on an envelope, etc. )

definitions.text_mt: Ħażen flus, ħin, jew riżorsi oħra għall-użu futur

definitions.text_en: to be spared (of trouble, work, etc.)
definitions.text_mt: Evita li jkollu jgħaddi minn inkwiet jew xogħol mhux meħtieġ

usage_examples.mt: Jekk tiffranka ftit kull xahar, tkun tista' tixtri karozza ġdida.
usage_examples.en: If you save a little every month, you will be able to buy a new car.

usage_examples.mt: Bix-xarabank, niffranka ħafna ħin meta mmur ix-xogħol.
usage_examples.en: By taking the bus, I save a lot of time when I go to work.

usage_examples.mt: Huma ġew iffrankati milli jkollhom jgħaddu mill-inkwiet kollu.
usage_examples.en: They were spared from having to go through all the trouble.

etymology_chain.definition: to frequent, to go regularly to, to patronize

definitions.text_mt: Żar jew mar f'post spiss u b'mod regolari

usage_examples.mt: Huwa jiffrekwenta dak il-każin kull nhar ta' Sibt.
usage_examples.en: He frequents that club every Saturday.

usage_examples.mt: Hija ffrekwenat l-istess skola għal ħames snin.
usage_examples.en: She attended the same school for five years.

usage_examples.mt: Iż-żgħażagħ jiffrekwentaw il-bajja matul is-sajf.
usage_examples.en: Young people frequent the beach during the summer.

definitions.text_mt: Biddel xi ħaġa fis-silġ billi naqqas it-temperatura tagħha
Biddilha fis-silġ minħabba l-kesħa estrema
Sar silġ minħabba t-temperatura baxxa
Sar silġ, ikkonverta f'silġ

usage_examples.mt: Jekk tiffriża l-ilma, isir silġ.
usage_examples.en: If you freeze water, it turns into ice.

usage_examples.mt: Qegħda niffriża l-laħam biex inżammu għal għada.
usage_examples.en: I am freezing the meat to keep it for tomorrow.

usage_examples.mt: Il-lagi ffriżaw fix-xitwa li għaddiet.
usage_examples.en: The lakes froze last winter.

etymology_chain.definition: to defraud, to swindle, to cheat, to deceive

definitions.text_mt: Ħa flushom ta' xi ħadd b'qerq jew bl-ingann

usage_examples.mt: L-avukat ffroda lill-konsumaturi b'investiment falz.
usage_examples.en: The lawyer defrauded customers with a fake investment.

usage_examples.mt: Min jiffroda n-nies jispiċċa l-ħabs.
usage_examples.en: He who defrauds people ends up in prison.

definitions.text_en: to face, to front, to defy
definitions.text_mt: Qagħad wiċċ imb wiċċ ma' periklu, sfida, jew sitwazzjoni diffiċli

usage_examples.mt: Is-suldat ffronta l-għadu mingħajr ebda biża'.
usage_examples.en: The soldier faced the enemy without any fear.

usage_examples.mt: Għandna niffrontaw il-problemi tas-soċjetà b'determinazzjoni.
usage_examples.en: We must confront society's problems with determination.

definitions.text_mt: Figarina żgħira, spiss imnaqqxa fuq il-pruwa ta' bastiment

usage_examples.mt: Il-fgajra fuq il-bastiment tal-qedem kienet imnaqqxa mill-injam.
usage_examples.en: The small figurehead on the old ship was carved from wood.

usage_examples.mt: Dawn il-fgajriet huma eżempju sabiħ ta' arti navali.
usage_examples.en: These small figureheads are a beautiful example of naval art.
